name: better-cortico-world-netease-companion
description: 和表达助手插件一起使用有奇效！读取网易云音乐、QQ 音乐、酷狗音乐、酷我音乐与 Spotify 曲目（优先 SMTC，必要时窗口标题），设置中按官方播放器优先级排序并保持切换稳定；新增读取诊断页，可查看全部会话、窗口候选与选择原因；切歌后让桌宠参考评论区、歌曲百科、歌手资料与歌词主动陪听，支持切歌报幕、同曲分段、评论侧重轮换与副歌动作建议；能记住单曲笔记、听感标签和多日听歌历史，并记录听歌排名与个人画像；可在用户明确要求时暂停/切歌，也能搜歌并给出链接。只读元数据，不采集音频，不需要 API Key。

en.description: Pairs with your desktop pet while you listen: reads what NetEase, QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo or Spotify is playing (SMTC first, window-title fallback), comments on track changes, follows the song in segments, and may borrow the figure's own actions at the chorus. Remembers song notes, feel tags, daily history, rankings and a taste profile; memory can live in a folder you choose, including a synced drive. Can pause, resume or skip, or search a track on request. Metadata only, no audio, no API key.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run describe && npm run check
